title: Stone Gambling Yields Divine Medicine
summary: Jiang Taixu has forbidden anyone to hunt immortal medicine for him, so Ye Fan decides to find divine medicine by gambling on stones instead. He challenges Nangong Qi of the Ancient Source Technique clan, an heir of the Earth Source Masters, at Yaoguang's Sky Stone Garden in the Holy City, each side starting with 1.5 million catties. In round one Nangong cuts 500,000 worth, while Ye Fan buys ten cheap Wind-Moving stones, one of which hides a primordial insect worth 800,000, and wins. In round two Nangong's 'Foolish Elephant' stone holds the head of an ancient royal clan member. Ye Fan strengthens his Heavenly Source divine sense with a Gallstone and survives a trap Nangong planted in a Red Fire Stone, absorbing its blast, and Nangong answers with the Earth Meridian Dragon Transformation Technique. Ye Fan then safely cuts a Demon Womb stone, and a huge surge of life suggests a Qilin inside.
